- **The brain didn't help here:** looking up Marrow Agrisupply from Hollis's conversation found no facts. The Gate 47 note sits in Pree's private notes, so other members can't look it up there. If the team will keep asking about this, the fact needs to go on a shared account page.
- **A mistake in my reply:** I called Pree "she," but Pree hasn't said what pronouns she uses. I can't edit the posted message. From now on I'll refer to Pree by name.
